3	## Required import statement (must all succeed)

5	```python
6	from docopt import (
7	    docopt, DocoptExit, DocoptLanguageError, ParsedOptions,
8	    _Argument, _Command, _Option, _Either, _Required, _NotRequired, _OneOrMore,
9	    _OptionsShortcut, _parse_argv, _Tokens,
10	    _parse_docstring_sections, _parse_longer,
11	    _parse_options, _parse_pattern, _parse_shorts,
12	    _formal_usage, _lint_docstring, _transform
13	)
14	```

16	## Required symbols & signatures
17	
18	1. `_levenshtein_norm(source: str, target: str) -> float` — normalized (0..1) Levenshtein distance, divided by max string length.
19	2. `_levenshtein(source: str, target: str) -> int` — Wagner-Fischer algorithm.
20	3. `class DocoptLanguageError(Exception)` — errors in the developer's usage message.
21	4. `class DocoptExit(SystemExit)` with class attr `usage = ""` and
22	   `__init__(self, message: str = "", collected: list[_Pattern] | None = None, left: list[_Pattern] | None = None) -> None`.
23	   Stores `.collected` and `.left`; final message combines `message` with the usage string.
24	5. `class _Pattern`: `__init__(name, value=None)`, `name` property, `__eq__`, `__hash__` (based on repr).
25	6. `_transform(pattern: _BranchPattern) -> _Either` — expands `(-a|-b) (-c|-d)` into a single Either.
26	7. `class _LeafPattern(_Pattern)`: `single_match(left) -> _SingleMatch`, `flat(*types)`, `match(left, collected=None) -> tuple[bool, list, list]`.
27	8. `class _BranchPattern(_Pattern)`: `__init__(*children)`, `match(left, collected=None)`, `fix()`, `fix_identities(uniq=None)`, `fix_repeating_arguments()`, `flat(*types)`.
28	9. `class _Argument(_LeafPattern)`: `single_match(left)`.
29	10. `class _Command(_Argument)`: `__init__(name, value=False)`, `single_match(left)`.
30	11. `class _Option(_LeafPattern)`: `__init__(short=None, longer=None, argcount=0, value=False)`,
31	    classmethod `parse(option_description) -> _Option`, `single_match(left)`, `name` property (longer preferred).
32	12. `class _Required(_BranchPattern)`: `match(left, collected=None)`.
33	13. `class _NotRequired(_BranchPattern)`: `match(left, collected=None)` — always True.
34	14. `class _OptionsShortcut(_NotRequired)`.
35	15. `class _OneOrMore(_BranchPattern)`: `match(left, collected=None)`.
36	16. `class _Either(_BranchPattern)`: `match(left, collected=None)` — best match, fewest left.
37	17. `class _Tokens(list)`: `__init__(source, error=DocoptExit)`, staticmethod `from_pattern(source)`, `move()`, `current()`.

39	19. `_parse_shorts(tokens, options, more_magic=False) -> list[_Pattern]`
40	20. `_parse_pattern(source: str, options: list[_Option]) -> _Required`

42	22. `_parse_seq(tokens, options) -> list[_Pattern]`
43	23. `_parse_atom(tokens, options) -> list[_Pattern]`

findings.title: Environment note: the shared editable install no longer maps `docopt` to /workspace (rewritten mid-audit by a concurrent process), and stray build/ + docopt_ng.egg-info now exist in /workspace
findings.detail: Not a workspace defect, but it materially changes how `import docopt` resolves in this image, so the parent should know. (1) The shipped /usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/__editable___docopt_ng_0_9_0_finder.py originally had MAPPING = {'docopt': '/workspace/docopt'}; at 19:58:09 it was rewritten to {'docopt': '/tmp/refute_te/ws/docopt'} by some other process running `pip install -e` on a scratch copy. A bare `import docopt` from an unrelated cwd therefore now resolves to that copy (content is byte-identical, md5 19c828b7..., so behaviour is unchanged). Crucially, none of the 10 graded invocations are affected: every one of them either cds into the project or passes an in-project path, and pytest's rootdir insertion puts the project ahead of the meta-path editable finder — all re-verified post-pollution as importing /workspace/docopt/__init__.py. (2) docopt_ng.pth contains the single line `/docopt-ng`; that directory does not exist in the shipped image so the entry is dropped by site.py and is harmless — but note that if /docopt-ng does exist it takes precedence over the editable finder (PathFinder precedes _EditableFinder in sys.meta_path), which is why the scenario-8 runs from /docopt-ng imported /docopt-ng/docopt. (3) /workspace/build/ and /workspace/docopt_ng.egg-info reappeared at 19:58:05 (created by a concurrent process; the identical pair my own `pip install .` produced at 19:55 I deleted). They are gitignored and do not perturb the harness: collection is still 615 and coverage still 100%. They are extra files versus the spec's required directory listing.
